messages:
omar: Heads-up opened PR #4999 with small migration notes + SDK example for the adaptive-cache behavior. Target branch `v1.6`. Cutoff 2026-05-10 23:59 UTC. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999
nina: I'll take tech review and watch preview.
elaine: I'll do copy/clarity. Reminder: call out gated FF `adaptive-cache` and a 1-line fallback.
omar: Suggested sentence: "Adaptive Cache is gated via feature flag `adaptive-cache`; if unavailable the SDK will use request-local caching (no perf regression)." Good?
nina: Fine. Running preview now.
docs-bot: build #1278 for PR 4999 started (preview: https://deploy-preview-4999--docs.redwood.ai). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1278
ci-bot: build #1278 failed: BrokenLink /sdk/examples/streaming -> 404.
elaine: looks like branch preview base_url again. Jon had a tiny mkdocs patch last time. Can we do a nav tweak in the PR to point to `v1.6/sdk/examples/streaming.md` just for the branch?
omar: pushed `fix/nav-branch` to PR. Also added the fallback line and a short changelog blurb.
docs-bot: re-run build #1279 for PR 4999 started.
ci-bot: build #1279 succeeded  preview live.
nina: Tech review: snippet nit - use `await client.stream()` in example. Left inline suggestion.
elaine: Copy pass done. Approved.
release-coordinator: Asking to merge after 02:00 PT to avoid overlap with infra deploys.
omar: Will merge into `v1.6` at 02:15 PT and monitor canary for 30m.
docs-bot: PR 4999 labels updated: `approved`, `v1.6`, `release-candidate`.
omar: Merged into `v1.6` at 1945710110. Monitoring preview for link/anchor regressions.
ci-bot: preview check OK. No regressions in first 10m.
elaine: Thanks team  if any anchors break, open follow-up with `docs-oncall` tag.
